description: Uniform-rollout exploration statistics under the reactive vs masked action rule (thesis: 98.2% of uniform rollouts end on a revisit within a median of five steps; goal rate 1.5% reactive vs 51.2% masked at eps=1; 89.2% at eps=0.05 with the Dijkstra next hop as greedy action).

source_mapping.note: The 'as-used density' here is n_chords=1250 total chords (the density-axis analogue of the legacy extra_edges=2 preset, ~1,236 chords), not the extra_edges=2 graph itself. blockers.py's own uniform goal rates at n_chords=1250 are 1.9% reactive / 49.8% masked (different pair sample, 20x100 rollouts); the thesis's 1.5% / 51.2% are the revisit_rules.py values (15x80 rollouts).
